title: Scott Andrews taken to space command as a child for alien communication
place_text: Air Force base with a space command center

tellings.quote: class and he was taken to, uh, space command to the an Air Force base with a space command center and was doing kind of intuitive communications with aliens.

plain: A man named Scott Andrews says that as a child he was taken out of class to an Air Force base with a space command center, where he did what Michels calls "intuitive communications with aliens." Michels relays this from Andrews during a conversation with Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says he was hired to talk to aliens, and if true it would mean the military used children with psychic gifts to reach non-human beings.
